releaseNotes: My Diary 1.0.189: Private Locker writing-only, encrypted search/editing, four-digit Diary-style PIN, Pattern, Favourite Name recovery and separate Android Keystore fingerprint. Diary Lock remains unchanged.
webReleaseNotes: My Diary Web Update 287: Fixed Private Locker Lock Off / Lock On buttons not appearing by mounting the existing Pattern/Fingerprint controls row below Private Locker search. Existing PIN confirmation and Lock On gate are retained. Diary Lock and Note Lock unchanged.
